name: The Paramount

evidence.note: Venue description says shows can be standing, hybrid or fully seated, with a large main-level dance floor plus balcony and mezzanine seating.
Capacity guide describes a general-admission standing floor of roughly 950 that can be turned into table seating.
Official calendar lists Almost Queen on Sat Oct 3 and Skillet on Sun Oct 4.

dancing.notes: At standing shows the main floor in front of the stage is open, and fans move and dance there. Some shows add tables or chairs, so check the ticket type before you go.

description: A restored 1920s theater in Huntington village that is now a 1,500-capacity concert hall for touring bands, tribute acts and comedy, with balcony seats and a large main floor.
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: paramountny.com, youtube.com, donyc.com.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Both Ira gigs confirmed on the official calendar. The same building has a separate downstairs bar, Spotlight at The Paramount (spotlightny.com), which has its own DJ dance nights; do not confuse the two rooms. Whether each show is standing or seated varies.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Full name is now 'The Paramount in Concert with Northwell' (older logos show a TD Bank sponsorship). Current description is broadly right; capacity is about 1,555 (sources say 1,550-1,573), so '1,500-capacity' is close enough but could be updated to 'about 1,500'. No general opening hours apart from the box office; show times vary. Booking is through Live Nation via the hitusup@ email, so bookingUrl left empty. Spotlight at The Paramount and Ella's (next door) are separate rooms on the same site. YouTube channel is not linked from the site but matches by name, address and content.
hours: Box office Tue-Sun 12 PM-6 PM (until 9 PM on show days); show times vary

logo.alt: The Paramount logo: the words The Paramount in large distressed white letters, with 'in concert with Northwell' underneath

evidence.note: Venue site gives 370 New York Avenue, Huntington NY 11743, (631) 673-7300 and hitusup@paramountny.com, and links Instagram, Facebook, X and TikTok.

Info page: box office Tue-Sun 12-6 PM with extended hours to 9 PM on show days; booking requests go to hitusup@paramountny.com (forwarded to Live Nation); elevator to the main floor; Spotlight and Ella's are next door.
YouTube channel 'The Paramount in Concert with Northwell' describes the Huntington venue opened in 2011 and booked by Live Nation.
Listing says the venue opened September 30, 2011 with about 1,555 capacity and hosts concerts, comedy and boxing.
